0.5 to 10, in 0.5 steps. Higher values include more neighbors.
Click to reset to 1 sigma. Changes apply on the next Grow or Shrink.

Grow selection

Shrink selection
Remove selected splats touching unselected splats

Connected colors

On: match only the connected region in the current view
